$comment: Hand-maintained ground truth for the 13 execution units a cycle transition actually runs (model α, AI full orchestration). Read against real scripts on 2026-08-06 (background: docs/CYCLE_GATE.md model α runbook + docs/VALIDATOR_RENEWAL.md 新SOP were missing steps 7.5 (scp the Mac-signed fragment to the host) and 8.5 (push the two canonical anchor feeds) — buried in the prose of neighboring steps instead of being their own line item). Step 0 (operator's Metal Wallet web AddValidator submit) is deliberately NOT listed here: docs/CYCLE_GATE.md itself says 'Step 0 is the operator's own wallet action (no script, no gate)', so it is not a script-driven execution unit — it still has its own doc entry (0. / ⓪), just outside this machine-checked list of 13.
source_of_truth: docs/CYCLE_GATE.md 'Operator runbook (= cycle transitions, model α)' section + docs/VALIDATOR_RENEWAL.md '新 SOP' 当日順序 section. Both must carry every step below (as a literal substring match of that step's *_pattern) or tests/cycle-transition-steps/test-cycle-transition-steps.sh fails. Add a step here AND to both docs in the same commit.

steps.summary: Wait for the node-info cron tick to reflect the new AddValidator entry's endTime before recording anything against it.
Close out cycle N's uptime record on the validator host.
Append cycle N's row to cycle-history.jsonl and publish it.
Mac: regenerate identity.json for the new cycle, commit + push + wait for deploy.
Host: compose the fresh anchor-source.json (3-branch DAG) for the new cycle.
Mac: verify + commit the host-composed anchor-source.json, push + wait for deploy.
Mac: mainnet dry run — gate-4 material, no recompose.
steps.validator_renewal_pattern: ⑦-b gate 4 材料(mainnet dry run)

steps.summary: Mac: unlock mainnet keystore, sign + broadcast the 4-action anchor pack via bin/safe-broadcast.

Mac -> host: scp the sign-anchor-event.sh output fragment (default /tmp/fya-mainnet-sign-output.json) to the host, where step 8's gen-anchor-receipt.sh --input= reads it. Added 2026-08-06 — previously only described in step 7c's/8's prose, never its own line item.
Host: gen-anchor-receipt.sh (7-gate verify) + append-anchor-history.sh (which, since 2026-08-06 / 77fd09d, also auto-pushes the two R18 per-anchor archive files as a best-effort side effect).

Host: push the two CANONICAL flat files (anchor-receipt.json, anchor-history.jsonl) — the only publish step left manual after 2026-08-06; the R18 archive copies are automatic (see step 8). Added 2026-08-06 — previously not documented as a step at all, so operators had no record of needing to run it.
steps.cycle_gate_pattern: 8.5. **host — push the two canonical flat files.**

steps.summary: Host: resume-after-cycle-start.sh --apply (Phase 1 verify -> Phase 2 atomic state write -> Phase 3 report). No broadcast.
